title: Bounded representatives and bounded roofs in the derived category
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $D^b(R)$ be the bounded derived category of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Every $C\in D^b(R)$ admits integers $a\le b$, a cochain complex of $R$-modules $K$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with $K^n=0$ for $n<a$ or $n>b$, and an isomorphism $C\cong Q(K)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. If $K$ and $L$ are bounded representatives of $C$ and $C'$, every morphism $u:C\to C'$ in the derived localization is represented by a roof $K\xleftarrow{s}M\xrightarrow{g}L$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with $M$ bounded and $s$ a quasi-isomorphism [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Any two such bounded roofs representing the same derived morphism have a common bounded refinement by quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; hence the resulting roof class is independent of the bounded representatives and of the chosen refinement.
